about: WP7 v2, the Tag blend's version 2: the film's music bed re-cut from the same take (Lyria 3.5, b2) to v2's timeline (cuts/blended-tag-v2/shots.json): the hook, the entrance and the walkthrough's first form as in v1 (0 to 54); the groove's second form to the Zoom cut (69.4, a thin bar at 68), Zoom on the second form, the thin bar at the Slack cut (92.2), Slack on the second form's last phrase; the dreamy part for the whole morning (100 to 110: the wake, the desk, the laptop brief); then v1's own last ten seconds: the fill (110), the take's rise under p11 as the globe pulls out (112), the finale's last bars and ring-out under the end card (114 to 120), and the end card's accent. bed.wav, bed-blended-v1.wav and Draft 3 are untouched. Remake: uv run --quiet demo-video/film/audio/music/tools/make_bed.py demo-video/film/audio/music/bed-blended-v2.edl.json

source.measured_by: tools/beatfit.py fit: 119.9973 BPM, first bar line at 0.067 s, the beat wanders 1.5 ms at most over the take

segments.note: 0-14: the hook and the sleeper on the take's light intro
14-20: the dreamy part as the tag glides across the room to the desk (idea C)
20-22: the take's fill on the push-in into the laptop
22-54: the walkthrough on the main groove's first form, as the take wrote it
54-68: the groove's second form from its fourth bar
68-70: one thin bar, the drums step back at the cut to Zoom (69.4)
92-94: the thin bar again, at the cut to Slack (92.2)
94-100: Slack on the second form's last phrase
100-110: the morning on the dreamy part: Ram wakes, the desk, the brief on the laptop (its soft hit starts 31 ms early, so the join ends 45 ms before the bar)
110-112: the dreamy part's own fill, as the brief ends and the globe begins (111.0)
112-114: the take's own rise into its finale, under p11 as the camera rises to the Earth
114-120: the finale's last bars and its ring-out under the end card (115.7), as in v1 and Draft 3's last 6 s

layers.note: the end card's accent, on the ring-out, 0.8 s after the card appears at 115.7 (as in v1)

gain_note: dB against the take, straight lines between the points: as v1 to 54; the walkthrough held under its lines; Zoom and Slack a little lower (dense speech); the morning's dreamy part and its fill; the rise held under p11 (111.6 to 114.0) and opened for the finale as the lights come on (114.0 to 114.5); Draft 3's own ending level under p12 and the end card
